notes.title: GO RUSH!! World Release & Massive Major Update Campaign
notes.notes:
Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links now gives players the ability to experience the world of GO RUSH!!, along with many new characters and cards!

And that's not all: we've also added Fusion Summoning to Rush Duels, plus a feature to add special processing to your cards—making them Chronicle Cards, which reflect your personal Dueling memories.

The game menus have also been revamped to provide greater immersion into the Yu-Gi-Oh! universe.

To celebrate the update, we're currently holding a special campaign which gives players "Ancient Gear Golem" (Rush Duels ver.) plus a Structure Deck and Packs from the latest BOX.

[url=steam://run/601510 style=button]Launch The Game Now[/url]

notes.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS World Release Celebration Campaign!
notes.notes:
A special campaign is here to celebrate the addition of a new world!

The new BOX "Link Revolution" has a "10 Packs + 1 UR" deal for free! In addition, log in to get the UR "Code Talker," a UR Dream Ticket, 1000 Gems, and a Skill Ticket! A new Structure Deck EX "Cyberse Code" with cards that supports Link Summoning is here as well! Seize the wind with them!

notes.title: "Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V" World Release & Celebration Campaign!
notes.notes:
[u][b]ARC-V World is finally here![/b][/u]
Check out the new characters, Skills, Decks, and cards!
A brand-new Summoning method "Pendulum Summon" is coming to Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links!

In celebration of the newly added world, following awesome items will be given to players who logged in after the maintenance planned on September 28th (JST).

[u][b]New UR cards "Stargazer Magician" and "Timegazer Magician"[/b][/u]
A Prismatic "Stargazer Magician" and "Timegazer Magician" which are the cards from Yuya Sakaki, the main character of "Yu-Gi-Oh! Arc-V," will be given to the players!

[u][b]1000 Gems and UR/SR Dream Tickets[/b][/u]
Login to get 1000 Gems! In addition, you can receive a total of 6 Card Tickets which are 1 "UR Dream Ticket (Glossy)," 1 "SR Dream Ticket (Glossy)," 1 "UR Ticket (Prismatic)," 1 "UR Ticket," 1 "SR Ticket (Prismatic)," and 1 "SR Ticket" if you logged in 6 days during the campaign. You can use these tickets to get everyone's favorite "Dark Magician" and "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" as well! You can also get popular cards such as "Mystical Space Typhoon" and "Lightning Vortex" from UR/SR Dream Tickets!

[u][b]Skill Ticket[/b][/u]
With this item, you can get Skills that can be obtained by Dueling against Legendary Duelists and other players.
*Only Skill for any character that was added to the game prior to September 27th (JST) is available.

[u][b]Celebration Game Mat & Card Sleeves[/b][/u]
A Game Mat and Card Sleeves themed around Yami Yugi and Yuya Sakaki.

In addition, the new Main BOX "Pendulum Genesis" that contains Yuya's ace monster "Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon" is now available!
Don't miss out the brand-new Structure Deck "Magicians Arc" that supports Pendulum Summoning as well!

Use the new Pendulum Summoning and hone your skills in the newly added Duel World!
Get ready to swing into action!

notes.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links ZEXAL World Release Celebration Campaign!
notes.notes:
The long-anticipated ZEXAL world is finally here! A powerful new form of Summoning called “Xyz Summoning” has arrived in Duel Links, and we’re celebrating with a bunch of free in-game cards and items! Check out the rewards you’ll receive for logging in during the ZEXAL world Release Celebration Campaign!

[u]Lead Your Forces Into Battle With Zubaba General![/u]
Acquire your first Xyz Monster in Duel Links right away by logging in to get a Prismatic Zubaba General! Xyz Monsters are black-framed monsters that you can Special Summon from your Extra Deck by using monsters on your field as materials. The monsters used to Summon an Xyz Monster become Xyz Materials that attach to the Summoned Xyz Monster. Unlike other monsters, Xyz Monsters have “Ranks” instead of “Levels”. Different Xyz Monsters require different materials to Summon them, but an Xyz Monster’s Rank usually matches the Level of the monsters used to Xyz Summon it.

Take a look at Zubaba General, for example. You can Summon this Rank 4 monster from your Extra Deck by combining any 2 Level 4 monsters. Those 2 monsters become Xyz Materials attached to Zubaba General, and you can use those Xyz Materials to fuel its effect. By sending an Xyz Material attached to Zubaba General to the Graveyard, you can equip your Zubaba General with a Warrior-Type monster from your hand. Zubaba General starts with 2000 ATK, but gains ATK equal to the total ATK of all monsters equipped to it. That means its effect will easily let you raise its ATK to 4000 and above so that you can wipe out your opponent with a single attack!

[u]Go Gaga Over Gagagaga Magician![/u]
Monsters that can change their Levels are the most flexible in helping to perform an Xyz Summon. That’s what makes Gagaga Magician an impressive card in the ZEXAL era. Gagaga Magician is a Level 4 monster to start, but its effect lets you change its Level to any Level between 1 and 8 inclusive. That makes it useful for Xyz Summoning monsters from Ranks 1 through 8. You’ll receive a Prismatic UR Gagaga Magician just for logging in during the ZEXAL world Release Celebration Campaign!

[u]New Game Mat and Sleeves![/u]
Duelists logging in during the ZEXAL world Release Celebration Campaign will also receive an exclusive new Game Mat featuring Yuma Tsukumo, Astral, and Yami Yugi. Yuma Tsukumo and Astral are the main protagonists of the Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL series, so using this new Game Mat is the perfect way to show off your enthusiasm for the release of ZEXAL world. Matching Card Sleeves featuring those same characters are also available as a reward for logging in.

[u]FREE Gems and Dream Tickets![/u]
As part of the ZEXAL world Release Celebration Campaign, Duelists that log in will receive 1000 free Gems as well as an UR and SR Dream Ticket. You can use these Gems to get booster packs from the shop, including packs of the 30th Main BOX that includes the iconic Number 39: Utopia Xyz Monster. You can also use them to get the new Structure Deck that features Gagaga Cowboy. The two Dream Tickets can be used to get nearly any Ultra Rare card and Super Rare card previously released in Duel Links, so they’re perfect for helping you finish up a Deck you’ve been working on. In addition, logging in during the ZEXAL world Celebration Campaign will also get you a Prismatic UR Ticket, a regular UR Ticket, a Prismatic SR Ticket, and a regular SR Ticket, which you can use to claim UR and SR cards from a more limited selection.

[u]New Skill Ticket![/u]
Finally, as part of the ZEXAL world Release Celebration Campaign, Duelists that log in will receive a “Skill Ticket” that can be used to give any character a previously available Skill. This is the perfect item to help you get the Skill you want on a specific character without going through the effort of unlocking that Skill.

In addition to all of these log-in freebies, ZEXAL world introduces new characters, new cards, and a whole new place to explore. Check it out and start Xyz Summoning powerful monsters right away!

notes.title: Regarding Display Issues with the PC Version
notes.notes:
Currently, the following issue has been occurring with the PC version of “Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links” Ver. 3.0.0.

Screen will glitch when setting your PC to a language that does not support a “. (period)” as a Decimal Symbol or a “, (comma)” as a Digit grouping Symbol under “Formats” in the “Region and Language” settings.

We are currently working on fixing this issue, and appreciate your patience.

Until the issue is resolved, you can change to languages such as English (United States) or Japanese in “Region and Language” settings to display correctly.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

Thank you for playing “Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links.”

notes.title: Update: Regarding Shop Maintenance
notes.notes:
The following issue had been occurring:

・Content sold at the Shop was priced incorrectly for players paying in Euros, Norwegian krone, and Colombian peso.

This issue has been fixed, and the Shop in the Steam version has been set to the correct prices.
Along with this, the Shop maintenance has ended, and players are now able to use the Shop.

According to our investigation, no purchases were made at the incorrect prices.

We sincerely apologize for the trouble and confusion, and appreciate your patience.

Thank you for playing "Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links."
